en.t: The Museum of Contemporary Art (Croatian: Muzej suvremene umjetnosti, often abbreviated to MSU) is a contemporary art museum located on Dubrovnik Avenue in Zagreb, Croatia. It is the biggest and most modern museum in the country. Vesna Meštrić is current director of MSU, replacing Zdenka Badovinac in late 2023 first temporarily and as of 2024 officially.

hr.t: Muzej suvremene umjetnosti je muzej u Zagrebu. Nalazi se na adresi Avenija Dubrovnik 17 u Novom Zagrebu u zagrebačkom naselju Središću. Građen je prema projektu arhitekta Igora Franića. Kamen temeljac je postavljen 2003., a muzej je otvoren 11. prosinca 2009.
Vratareva kućica u Parku Maksimir nalazi se pored glavnog ulaza u park.
